description:
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Spark Double.
Choose to have Spark Double enter the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Gilraen.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Human and/or Noble you control.
Activate Spark Double by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Gilraen.
When Gilraen enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Human and/or Noble you control.
Repeat.
If you control one additional Human and/or Noble, this combo will net infinite colorless mana.
